samples.summary: No test covers the spill-handling branches of `clearCellsUnderMerge` on the new paste path (or anywhere)
samples.evidence: `clearCellsUnderMerge` (sheet.ts ~2596) contains substantial logic for cells under a newly created merge: skipping ghost cells (`cell.spillAnchor`), deleting a spill anchor's ghosts, `clearSpillBlockers`, preserving `cell.s` styles, and `consumeSpillBlocker` -> `unblockedAnchors`. The paste path now calls it via `applyPasteMerges`, and `paste` grew new plumbing (`changedSrefs.size > 0 || unblockedAnchors.size > 0`, seeding `dependantsMap` with unblocked anchors, sheet.ts 2326-2350). None of the new tests in packages/sheets/test/sheet/merge.test.ts create a spilled formula, a blocked spill, or a styled covered cell before pasting a merge over it; `rg 'spill' packages/sheets/test/sheet` matches only calculation/data-validation/formatting tests (none of which paste merges). So if pasting a merge over a spill anchor orphans ghosts or fails to re-attempt a blocked spill, no test fails — an outcome that leaves stale ghost cells visible on the grid.

samples.summary: `crossesFreezePane`'s frozen-column branch is untested for both the paste and the move refusal
samples.evidence: The new helper checks rows and columns, but both new refusal tests ('should refuse a paste that lands a block across a frozen row' and 'should refuse a drag-move that lands a block across a frozen row') call `setFreezePane(2, 0)` — only frozen rows. No test uses a non-zero frozenCols with a horizontally spanning block, so a broken/inverted column comparison in `crossesFreezePane` would ship undetected (and it also backs `canMergeSelection`, which was refactored onto it).

samples.summary: Removal of `clearCopyBuffer()` from the view paste handlers has no test at the view layer
samples.evidence: worksheet.ts:4941 and spreadsheet.ts:724 stop clearing the copy buffer after `paste`. The only coverage is sheet-level ('should propagate merges on a second paste from the same copy'), which calls `sheet.paste` directly and never exercises the view handler. `rg 'paste' packages/sheets/test/view` only finds a `vi.fn()` mock in worksheet-keymap.test.ts, i.e. the sheet is mocked away there, so the view's paste flow (including that it no longer clears the buffer, and that Escape still does at worksheet.ts:5118) is asserted nowhere.

samples.summary: The HTML (spreadsheet) paste branch's new `destStart` normalization is untested
samples.evidence: `html2grid(html, destStart)` at sheet.ts:2290 changed from `this.activeCell` to the merge-normalized start, but the new normalization tests only cover the internal path ('should paste into the anchor when the active cell is covered') and the plain-TSV path ('should paste an external grid from the anchor too', `paste({text:'7'})`). No test passes `html` with `isSpreadsheetHtml` content while the active cell is covered by a merge, so a regression on that branch (value hidden under the block) would not fail the suite.

`snapshotMergesIn` filters out blocks the copied range only clips (`isRangeInRange`), documented as a guard for programmatic callers since the UI expands selections. No test in merge.test.ts copies a range that clips a merged block (e.g. calling `selectStart/selectEnd` then invoking copy on a range that partially overlaps a block via a programmatic range), so if the filter were dropped, a half-block would be recorded and re-created at the destination with no failing test.
searchedFor: read new 'Sheet merge + copy-paste' describe in merge.test.ts

samples.summary: `liveMergesAmong` is only tested via the cut path; the documented copy-snapshot semantics (unmerge after copy) is untested
samples.evidence: The doc comment on `copyBuffer.merges` states that unmerging after a copy does not retro-edit the clipboard, so a later paste still reproduces the copied layout. Only the cut variant is covered ('should refuse a cut whose recorded block was unmerged before pasting'). There is no test that copies a merged block, unmerges the source, pastes, and asserts the block is still re-created at the destination — the stated contract for the non-cut path.

samples.summary: The `rangeOf` large-grid test builds 200k Map entries and does not assert the failure mode it names
samples.evidence: The test titled 'should not overflow the stack on a grid with many cells' only asserts the bounding range; it would pass on any implementation that returns correct bounds and happens not to spread. It is a valid regression guard (the old `Math.min(...rows)` would throw RangeError), but it is a single-column grid so it never exercises the column-bound folding at scale, and it adds a 200k-iteration setup to every run.

verdict.reason: The spill-handling branches of `clearCellsUnderMerge` (sheet.ts:2580-2605) and the new paste plumbing that consumes them (sheet.ts:2328-2351) have no test anywhere. A repo-wide case-insensitive grep for `spill` hits only 8 test files (formula.test.ts, worksheet-grid.test.ts, style-mutation.test.ts, calculation.test.ts, data-validation.test.ts, formatting.test.ts, and two docs tests), none of which paste or drag-move a merged block. Searching for spill *without* the word (MUNIT/MINVERSE/MMULT/TRANSPOSE/SEQUENCE/UNIQUE/SORT/FILTER) returns the same file set; merge.test.ts uses only scalar formulas (lines 38, 175, 439). I also followed the second call site: calculation.test.ts:202 exercises a drag-move that carries a blocker away, but through moveRangeTo's own source-clearing path (sheet.ts:2739-2760) with no merge involved, so clearCellsUnderMerge is never reached with a spill cell. The nearest coverage — merge.test.ts:192 and merge.test.ts:455 — places only a plain string under the block, which exits via the plain-delete path at sheet.ts:2602 and would pass whether or not the ghost-cleanup, blocked-spill, style-preservation, or unblockedAnchors branches work. Failure would leave orphaned ghost cells visible on the grid or a blocked spill never re-attempted: user-visible and data-affecting, so major under the test-adequacy rubric.
